thread:
Sam (eng-platform): Quick follow-up from the inference postmortemI sketched a minimal tracker and a proposed set of mitigations: https://internal/redwood/trackers/rollout-safety-2026
Priya (oncall): Nice. Can we prioritize items that reduce blast radius for customer-facing Dedicated pools?
Sam (eng-platform): Yespriority order I had: 1) enforced traffic caps at flag-level, 2) auto-rollback on runtime/quality regressions, 3) rollout pacing enforcement.
Lina (eng-sre): I'll take auto-rollback. Implementation note: detect abnormal error rate + QoS degradation signals (latency + 5xxs) for a model variant, trigger canary rollback to previous healthy variant. Need a small state machine to avoid flip-flop. ETA RFC: 2026-04-01, PR soon after.
Mei (eng-ml): For quality regressions we should use the eval-set runnercompare sample decodes against baseline metric (BLEU/ROUGE or custom QA accuracy) and surface delta. Thresholds configurable per org. I can own the eval integration. ETA: 2026-04-05.
Carlos (product): For blast-radius caps, proposal: per-flag rollout_slices: ["1%","10%","50%"], plus org allowlist and max_concurrency per-flag. UX: quick toggle to pause or cut to 0%. I'll mock the console flow. ETA: 2026-03-31.
Priya (oncall): We saw oscillation concern in postmortemhow will rollback avoid thrash?
Lina (eng-sre): Add hysteresis: require N windows (default 3) of violation and a cooldown window (default 15m) after rollback. Also prefer partial rollback (reduce to 0% slice) before full rollback.
Sam (eng-platform): Rollout pacing: min_ramp_time + max_step_pct. Enforce at router level and in the console when creating flags. I'll add an admission check to block ramps > policy. ETA: 2026-04-07.
Carlos (product): Add a preflight checklist visible in the console: smoke perf test, eval delta check, latency baseline, and a rollback plan link. Also a checkbox acknowledging risk.
Priya (oncall): Recurring-pattern detection: create weekly job to tag deployments with >2 incidents in 30d and auto-assign a follow-up owner. Who can add the job?
Lina (eng-sre): I'll add a Prometheus query + a small service to mark and create an issue in our tracker. Add a PD test channel and low-priority alert. ETA: 2026-04-03.
Mei (eng-ml): Suggest we keep a small curated regression set per customer profile; that helped identify quality drift in the incident. Will coordinate with Customer Success for sample selection.
Sam (eng-platform): Summary of owners/timelines (I added these to the tracker): Lina: auto-rollback RFC + implementation (2026-04-01), Lina: recurring-pattern job (2026-04-03), Carlos: blast-radius caps UI + policy (2026-03-31), Sam: rollout pacing enforcement + admission checks (2026-04-07), Mei: eval integration for rollback triggers (2026-04-05), Carlos: console preflight checklist (2026-03-31).
OpsBot: issue-bot created INF-8451 "rollout_pacing_admission_check" assigned to Sam. https://internal/redwood/issues/INF-8451 :robot_face:
Priya (oncall): Calendar: let's do a 30min checkpoint next Wed 10:30am. Sam please send invite and include tracker link.
Sam (eng-platform): Invite sent + tracker updated. Please paste PR/issue links into the tracker as they land. I'll keep a weekly digest until closed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
